ParsedRFSweep.description: Output of a parsed calibration measurement. Each output is a an RMEMeas object with shape (n,) where n is a coordinate dimension called (frequency) in GHz and the outputs are real valued numbers corresponding to the measurement result.

e_off.description: Calorimeter thermopile voltages in RF off state.

e_on.description: Calorimeter thermopile voltages in RF on state.

RF_source_on.description: Final value of the RF source.

E_off.description: Power inferred by the thermopile in calorimeters RF off state.

E_on.description: Power inferred by the thermopile in calorimeters RF on state.

zeta.description: Uncorrected effective efficiency of sensor 2 (internal DUT)

e_p2_off.description: Thermopile voltages of sensor at port 2 in RF off state.

e_p2_on.description: Thermopile voltages of sensor at port 2 in RF on state.

p2_fast.description: RF power measured by sensor 2 (internal DUT) \n\n during the fast RF off portion of a frequency point.

p2_slow.description: RF power measured by sensor 2 (internal DUT)  \n\n during the slow RF on portion of a frequency point

p3_fast.description: RF power measured by sensor 3 (external sidearm) \n\n during the fast RF off portion of a frequency point.

p3_slow.description: RF power measured by sensor 3 (external sidearm)  \n\n during the slow RF on portion of a frequency point

p2dc_on.description: RF power measured by sensor 2 (internal DUT) \n\n during the fast RF off portion of a frequency point.

p2dc_off_fast.description: RF power measured by sensor 2 (internal DUT) \n\n during the fast RF off portion of a frequency point.

p2dc_off_slow.description: RF power measured by sensor 2 (internal DUT)  \n\n during the slow RF on portion of a frequency point
